SPA solver for HE-based variance components with correction

Source: R/elastic.R
he_window_spa.Rd

SPA solver for HE-based variance components with correction

Usage

he_window_spa(
  filename,
  pheno,
  out_file,
  annotation = NULL,
  annot_names = NULL,
  loco_prs = NULL,
  prs_mask = NULL,
  chunk_size = 256,
  window_bp = 1e+06,
  do_windows = T,
  alpha = -1,
  covariates = NULL,
  cov_df = NA,
  SPA = T,
  spa_pval_threshold = 0.1,
  binary = F,
  binary_raw = NULL,
  coher = F,
  chr = NULL,
  batch_size = 64,
  n_threads = 0,
  max_window_chunks = 8,
  genes = NULL,
  kvik_summaries = NULL,
  acatv_mac = 10
)
